faqs.q: What details are required for a transport quote?
faqs.a: Share exact origin and destination, material, packaging, package count, total weight, dimensions, ready date, loading method, delivery terms and any special handling or documentation needs.

faqs.q: Can I request part load and full truckload options?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose ‘Please recommend’ when the shipment could suit either option. The team can assess the movement using the actual cargo and route details.

faqs.q: Does sending this enquiry confirm price or vehicle placement?
faqs.a: No. The enquiry gives Vidhi Transport the information needed to review the requirement. Price, service acceptance, vehicle placement and schedule require separate confirmation.

faqs.q: How quickly can I contact customer care?
faqs.a: Customer care is listed as available 8:00 AM–10:00 PM IST, daily. You can call +91 98253 21589 or email customercare@vidhitransport.com.
